classes.name: Proving Vanguard
classes.subtitle: Shield & Spear Frontliner
classes.description: A sturdy front-row fighter who excels at melee combat, shield defense, and heaving heavy obstacles.

classFeatures.name: Iron Footing
classFeatures.description: Steadfast stance grants +1 AC in battle.

classFeatures.name: Sweeping Thrust
classFeatures.description: A forceful spear lunge dealing bonus damage.

combat.text: You lunge forward with a sweeping spear thrust!

classes.name: Wayfarer Scout
classes.subtitle: Ranged Striker & Lockpicker
classes.description: An agile explorer who picks locks, spots hidden caches, and shoots past frontline guards.

classFeatures.name: Sharp Sight
classFeatures.description: Trained eyes grant +2 on Perception checks.

classFeatures.name: Pinning Arrow
classFeatures.description: A swift aimed shot that entangles the target.

combat.text: Your pinning arrow rattles the enemy and slows its footing!

classes.name: Runic Scholar
classes.subtitle: Arcane Tactician & Crafter
classes.description: A disciplined student of spells, riddles, and alchemy who turns arcane energy against groups of foes.

classFeatures.name: Focused Mind
classFeatures.description: Arcane discipline grants +2 on Investigation checks.

classFeatures.name: Guiding Spark
classFeatures.description: Unleash a crisp arcane bolt that bypasses cover.

combat.text: A guiding spark leaps straight past cover to strike your target!
